criteria.description: the conflict must occur at a roundabout entry rather than anywhere on the ring
criteria.reason: no criterion binds a conflict to a named junction feature

originalIntent: NHTSA pre-crash typology 28 plus UK TRL roundabout entry studies: the conflict is at entry, between an entering and a circulating vehicle, and is characterised by PET at the give-way line. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Roundabout entry/circulating conflict: the ego must yield to or be challenged by circulating traffic
